decisions.reason: A small software plugin close to the core offer costs little to maintain, and one year of market presence has not resolved its value, so the option stays open.
The ERP interface supports the firm's multichannel direction and has strategic value with low upkeep cost, so keeping it preserves future integration opportunities.
Price comparison tracking plugins are cheap to keep listed, and with prospects still uncertain after one year, keeping the option is justified despite overlap with D and E.
D overlaps with sibling price tracking plugins, which raises the chance of consolidation, but carrying cost is low and evidence of failure is lacking.
E is a redundant variant among several similar trackers and may be pruned later, but it is inexpensive to maintain while results remain unclear.
F is a low-cost reporting extension that complements A and the firm's analytics offer, so it is worth keeping while its value is still uncertain.
